Two families, drawn for one game
FROSTCUT
FROSTWORK

Frostcut is the display face: heavy, slightly condensed, and faceted — its bowls are cut at four segments to the quarter, so an O is a sixteen-sided stone rather than a circle. A few terminals hang an icicle. Frostwork is the UI face in Regular and Bold: tall x-height, open apertures, low contrast, terminals cut flat. One holds a title at 60px, the other holds a card at 13px.

Frostwork — regular, bold, and the small stuff

The caravan is nine wagons and a fire that will not last. Every camp you keep is a card you did not draw; every card you burn is a mile you did not walk. Bold is a second cut, not a smear — heavier stem and thin, a touch wider, so a headline in it holds its counters.
